parts.label: c
parts.text:
Place the mirror so that its reflecting surface lies along the line MM′. Place a pin at point A.
(c)
Place another pin B close to the mirror and along the line AD.

parts.label: d
parts.text:
View the images of pins A and B in the mirror. Place two pins F and G between your eye and
the mirror so that F, G and the images of A and B appear exactly one behind the other.

parts.label: e
parts.text:
Mark the positions of pins B, F and G on the ray trace sheet. Remove the pins and the mirror.
Using a rule draw a line joining G and F, and continue the line to meet the line MM′.

parts.text: Repeat the steps (c) to (e) using the same position of pin A but placing pin B on line AE.

parts.text:

Record the length y of the line.
